dedupe_keys.name: rte data portal apis for french electricity generation installed capacity consumption exchanges and market data

description: The RTE Data Portal is the API catalogue of the French transmission system operator, grouped into partners, generation, consumption, market and exchanges categories. After creating a free account, users subscribe to APIs and test them online. The Generation Installed Capacities API, version 1.1 created in April 2023, gives installed generating capacity connected to the transmission grid, aggregated by RTE from units above 1 MW reported by generators that belong to the UFE initiative, updated at least once a year in the last week of December. The Actual Generation API gives intraday net generation by sector and by unit in MW from remote measurements, with an estimation model for wind and photovoltaics, and weekly hydro reservoir fill rates. Other APIs cover generation forecasts from three days ahead to intraday and balancing capacity. The hand-off pointed to an older Generation Storage Park API listed on the French open data portal in 2017, which gave the generation and storage fleet by fuel, technology, network and region including the non-interconnected areas. Coverage is France. Caveats: an account and acceptance of the portal terms are needed, several API pages were temporarily unavailable on the day, and two balancing resources were reported down. Simulation uses are installed capacity and measured generation series for French power system models. Related records: data-odre-open-data-reseaux-energies offers open downloads from the French network operators.
